name: Text Anonymizer
description: Removes e-mail addresses and phone numbers from text or JSON documents before they leave the pipeline.

operations.label: Anonymize text
operations.description: Send each input file and receive a JSON document with the redacted text.

parameters.name: replacement
parameters.label: Replacement text
parameters.description: Text that replaces each detected personal identifier.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.label: API key
secrets.description: Key issued by the tool provider.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text or JSON document to anonymize.

outputs.name: anonymized
outputs.description: JSON with the redacted text and a count of removed identifiers.

instructions: Use this tool when a pipeline must remove e-mail addresses or phone numbers from text before storing, sharing or sending it. It processes one input file per call and returns JSON {"text": ..., "removed": n}. It does not detect names or addresses.
